archimate:Outcome.name: Unified Longitudinal Record Maintained Across All Episodes; Improved Chronic Disease Control and Continuity Metrics
archimate:Outcome.documentation: A single, continuously updated Longitudinal Patient Record and Care Pathway is maintained for each patient across preventive, acute, chronic, and rehabilitative episodes, resulting in measurable improvements in chronic disease control rates, preventive care uptake, and a reduced care continuity dropout rate across the population.
